[b]Political Parties of New Westmore[/b]
[i]Erene: 2000[/i]]

Westmore has a large group of morons in the Government who categorise themselves under factions known as political parties. As political parties, these stooges fight and squabble for absolute control across all levels of governance in the nation. They all can't agree with one another on anything, and are more akin to literal monkeys in tuxedos, but for how sh*t they are at actually leading Westmore, they haven't dug the country into a rut of doom for the most part, so good on them, I guess.
The current ruling group of morons are the Liberals, who are led by President Andrew Holt.

[b]Major Parties[/b]
These parties are affectionately known as the "Big Three" of Westmorian politics. Despite the fancy names and labels though, they are really just three different flavours of liberalism. The only thing that truly sets them apart is the way they think Westmore's economy should run - one advocates for an economy that is nannied by the government, another advocates for maximum capitalism, and another doesn't even have the foggiest about how a national economy actually works. As you read, take a guess to figure out which one advocates for which economic policy.

Pick your poison - we have moderate liberalism, conservative liberalism and the bastard child of the Western cultural zeitgeist - radical leftism.

[b]The Liberals[/b]
The Liberal Party is the major centre-left party of New Westmore. They have been in charge since 2019 under the wooden fist of President Holt, who is also the youngest President to ever take the seat at 32 years old. The Liberals are effectively the poster child of what it means to be a Westmorian - they are the right amount of socially progressive and are perceived to be intelligent enough to know what they're doing. Obviously, these qualities appeal greatly to the unwashed masses, who can't tell a voting slip apart from an eviction notice.

The Liberals are the oldest political party in New Westmore - their roots go all the way back to 1870, at the height of the era of the Colonial Republic. For a left-wing party, they are actually quite moderate by all standards in Westmore's society, but this is not a very high bar to clear given the Greens are considered to be the standard of radical leftism. The party mostly concerns itself with matters of economic and social policy - they firmly believe the government should have more control over the economy, and believe that no private company should be allowed to grow unchecked or unsupervised. On matters of society, the Liberals advocate for a myriad of things, such as gay rights, sapient rights, secularisation of the government and more. By far, it is the most popular political party, with a 70% support margin against its biggest opps, the National Union and the Greens.

[b]The National Union[/b]
The National Union is the major centre-right party and one of the Big Three of New Westmore. It has been in the opposition since 2019 under the considerably more solid fist of the oldest fart in Parliament at 89 years old, Gordon Macklemore. Usually, the National Union is voted into power if people believe Westmore's economy is going down the sh*tter, which it often does every now and again.

The Union is the second oldest party in New Westmore, but in comparison to the Liberals, they are very, very young. They were founded in 1920, 10 years after the nation federated, as a result of a merger between two groups of conservative stooges that went by the names of the Democratic Party and the National Rural Party of Westmore. The National Union primarily concerns itself with more economic freedoms, the expansion of the Westmore National Guard and policies that favour Christianity's presence in Westmore's society. Worry not, the National Union isn't a bunch of crazed alt-right pearl-clutchers with an outdated view of the world, because they do see eye-to-eye with the more liberal society of New Westmore on social topics like gay rights and sapient rights... for the most part.

[b]The Greens[/b]
The Greens are the third-largest party in New Westmore, but how they even got that status is a mystery in and of itself given the kind of reputation this party has with Westmorian society. By the nation's societal standards, the Greens are on the absolute fringe of politics and then some. Led by the loudest voice in the room and the freakiest man in all of Westmore, Paul Keating, the Greens have always been in the opposition since its conception in 1988. Yeah. They've had it rough from the start, but it's the price to pay for going where more grounded parties like the Liberals would never go.

The Greens are far more socially progressive than the Liberals, but where they are strong in social policy, they are known to be incredibly lacking in an actual understanding of economics, which is one of the main reasons why people never vote for them in droves. They are also known for being incredibly avant-garde in the way they protest and campaign, taking more provocative means such as... tearing all their clothes off and running naked in the streets of Dalesburg to protest something about the climate... or gluing themselves to the Hume Loop in a vain attempt to challenge Westmore's booming oil industry... we have no idea why anyone would do these things, but it is something the Greens appear to relish in doing. In any way, their unique methods of protesting and getting their message out there is another big reason why Westmorians don't like the Greens.[/spoiler]
